chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, from al-Ḥasan ibn Ziyād, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a man who urinates and then a small spot of his urine reaches part of his thigh, and he performs salat (prayer), then afterwards remembers that he had not washed it. He said: He should wash it and repeat his salat (prayer).
ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he remembers after prayer that urine had remained on his body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning najasah discovered after performing salat (prayer). If a person prays while a spot of urine remains unwashed on his body and only remembers afterward, he must wash it and repeat the prayer.
